description: Search Hugging Face models, datasets, or spaces with optional filters.

author.description: Optional author or organization name to filter results to.

direction.description: Optional sort direction sent to the Hub API (floored to an integer, e.g. -1 for descending).

limit.description: Optional maximum number of results to return (default 20, clamped to 1-100).

repo_type.description: Optional repository type to search: 'models', 'datasets', or 'spaces' (default 'models'; singular forms are also accepted).

search.description: Optional keyword search term matched against repository names and metadata.

sort.description: Optional field to sort results by, as accepted by the Hugging Face Hub API.

name: hub_repo_search
